source.text: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί, ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν, συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως, εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ, ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι.

records.literal_gloss: I want for you to know how great a struggle I have on behalf of you and those in Laodicea and as many as have not seen the face of me in [the] flesh, \v 2 that may be encouraged the hearts of them, having been knit together in love and unto all [the] riches of the full assurance of the understanding, unto [the] knowledge of the mystery of the God, Christ, \v 3 in whom are all the treasures of the wisdom and knowledge hidden.

en.L: For I want you to know how great a struggle I have for you and for those in Laodicea and for all who have not seen my face in [the] flesh, \v 2 so that their hearts may be encouraged, being knit together in love and for all [the] riches of the full assurance of understanding, for [the] knowledge of the mystery of God, {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 3 in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
en.B: I want you to know how hard I am struggling for you, for those in Laodicea, and for everyone who has never met me in person. \v 2 My aim is that their hearts may be encouraged as they are joined together in love, and that they may have all the riches of understanding held with full confidence, so that they know God's mystery, which is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \v 3 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge lie hidden.
en.R: I want you to know how hard I am working and praying for you, for the believers in Laodicea, and for all who have never seen me face to face. \v 2 I want them to be encouraged and joined together in love. I want them to have the rich blessing of understanding fully and being completely sure. Then they will know God's mystery, which is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \v 3 All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cuán grande lucha tengo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y por los de Laodicea y por cuantos no han visto mi rostro en [la] carne, \v 2 para que sean animados sus corazones, unidos en amor y para todas [las] riquezas de la plena certeza del entendimiento, para [el] conocimiento del misterio de Dios, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, \v 3 en quien están escondidos todos los tesoros de la sabiduría y del conocimiento.
es.B: Quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cuánto lucho por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, por los de Laodicea y por todos los que nunca me han conocido en persona. \v 2 Mi propósito es que cobren ánimo en su corazón, unidos en amor, y que alcancen toda la riqueza de un entendimiento pleno y seguro, para que conozcan el misterio de Dios, que es {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} mismo. \v 3 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} están escondidos todos los tesoros de la sabiduría y del conocimiento.
es.R: Quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cuánto me esfuerzo y oro por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, por los creyentes de Laodicea y por todos los que nunca me han visto cara a cara. \v 2 Quiero que todos ellos cobren ánimo y estén unidos en amor. Quiero que tengan la gran riqueza de entender bien y de estar completamente seguros. Así conocerán el misterio de Dios, que es {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} mismo. \v 3 Todos los tesoros de la sabiduría y del conocimiento están escondidos en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Car je veux que vous sachiez quel grand combat je soutiens pour vous et pour ceux de Laodicée et pour tous ceux qui n’ont pas vu mon visage dans la chair, \v 2 afin que leurs cœurs soient encouragés, étant unis ensemble dans l’amour et en vue de toute la richesse de la pleine assurance de l’intelligence, en vue de la connaissance du mystère de Dieu, {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, \v 3 en qui sont cachés tous les trésors de la sagesse et de la connaissance.
fr.B: Je veux que vous sachiez combien je lutte pour vous, pour ceux de Laodicée et pour tous ceux qui ne m’ont jamais rencontré en personne. \v 2 Mon but est que leurs cœurs soient encouragés, qu’ils soient unis dans l’amour et qu’ils aient toute la richesse d’une intelligence pleine et assurée, pour connaître le mystère de Dieu, qui est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. \v 3 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont cachés tous les trésors de la sagesse et de la connaissance.
fr.R: Je veux que vous sachiez combien je travaille et je prie pour vous, pour les croyants de Laodicée et pour tous ceux qui ne m’ont jamais vu face à face. \v 2 Je veux qu’ils soient encouragés et unis dans l’amour. Je veux qu’ils aient la riche bénédiction de tout comprendre et d’en être pleinement sûrs. Alors ils connaîtront le mystère de Dieu, qui est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. \v 3 Tous les trésors de la sagesse et de la connaissance sont cachés en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana nataka mjue jinsi lilivyo kubwa pambano nililo nalo kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya wale walio Laodikia na wote ambao hawajauona uso wangu katika mwili, \v 2 ili mioyo yao ifarijiwe, wakiwa wameunganishwa katika upendo na [kufikia] utajiri wote wa uhakika kamili wa ufahamu, [wapate] kuijua siri ya Mungu, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 3 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ziko hazina zote za hekima na maarifa zilizofichwa.
sw.B: Nataka mjue jinsi ninavyojitahidi sana kwa ajili yenu, kwa ajili ya walio Laodikia, na kwa ajili ya wote ambao hawajawahi kukutana nami ana kwa ana. \v 2 Lengo langu ni kwamba mioyo yao ipate nguvu na faraja, wakiwa wameunganishwa pamoja katika upendo, na kwamba wawe na utajiri wote wa ufahamu ulio thabiti kabisa, ili waijue siri ya Mungu, yaani {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. \v 3 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} zimefichwa hazina zote za hekima na maarifa.
sw.R: Nataka mjue jinsi ninavyojitahidi na kuomba kwa ajili yenu, kwa ajili ya waumini wa Laodikia, na kwa ajili ya wote ambao hawajawahi kuniona uso kwa uso. \v 2 Nataka watiwe moyo na kuunganishwa pamoja katika upendo. Nataka wawe na baraka kubwa ya kuelewa kikamilifu na kuwa na uhakika kabisa. Hapo watajua siri ya Mungu, ambayo ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. \v 3 Hazina zote za hekima na maarifa zimefichwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Vì tôi muốn anh chị em biết tôi đang chiến đấu lớn lao dường nào vì anh chị em, vì những người ở Lao-đi-xê và vì tất cả những ai chưa từng thấy mặt tôi trong xác thịt, \v 2 để lòng họ được khích lệ, được kết hợp với nhau trong tình yêu thương và [đạt] đến mọi sự giàu có của sự thông hiểu đầy trọn chắc chắn, đến sự hiểu biết sự mầu nhiệm của Đức Chúa Trời, là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 3 là Đấng mà trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mọi kho tàng của sự khôn ngoan và tri thức đều được giấu kín.
vi.B: Tôi muốn anh chị em biết tôi đang phải chiến đấu vất vả dường nào cho anh chị em, cho những người ở Lao-đi-xê và cho tất cả những ai chưa từng gặp mặt tôi. \v 2 Mục đích của tôi là để lòng họ được khích lệ khi được gắn bó với nhau trong tình yêu thương, và để họ có được mọi sự giàu có của sự thông hiểu với sự chắc chắn trọn vẹn, nhờ đó họ hiểu biết sự mầu nhiệm của Đức Chúa Trời, tức là chính {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. \v 3 Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mọi kho tàng của sự khôn ngoan và tri thức đều đang được giấu kín.
vi.R: Tôi muốn anh chị em biết tôi đang làm việc và cầu nguyện khó nhọc dường nào cho anh chị em, cho các tín hữu ở Lao-đi-xê, và cho tất cả những người chưa từng gặp mặt tôi. \v 2 Tôi muốn họ được khích lệ và gắn bó với nhau trong tình yêu thương. Tôi muốn họ có được phước lành dồi dào là hiểu biết trọn vẹn và hoàn toàn chắc chắn. Khi đó họ sẽ biết sự mầu nhiệm của Đức Chúa Trời, là chính {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. \v 3 Mọi kho tàng của sự khôn ngoan và tri thức đều được giấu kín trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 사실 나는 내가 여러분과 라오디게아에 있는 사람들과, 육신으로 내 얼굴을 보지 못한 모든 사람을 위하여 얼마나 큰 싸움을 하고 있는지 여러분이 알기를 원합니다. \v 2 이는 그들의 마음이 격려를 받고, 사랑 안에서 하나로 결합되어, 깨달음의 온전한 확신이 주는 모든 풍성함에 이르고, 하나님의 비밀, 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 아는 지식에 이르게 하려는 것입니다. \v 3 그분 안에는 지혜와 지식의 모든 보화가 감추어져 있습니다.
ko.B: 나는 내가 여러분과 라오디게아에 있는 사람들, 그리고 나를 직접 만나 본 적이 없는 모든 사람을 위해 얼마나 힘써 싸우고 있는지 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. \v 2 내가 바라는 것은 그들이 사랑 안에서 하나로 결합되어 마음에 용기를 얻고, 온전한 확신에서 오는 깨달음의 모든 풍성함을 누리며, 하나님의 비밀이신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 그분을 알게 되는 것입니다. \v 3 그분 안에 지혜와 지식의 모든 보화가 감추어져 있습니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분과 라오디게아의 믿는 사람들, 그리고 나를 한 번도 만나 보지 못한 모든 사람을 위해 내가 얼마나 애써 일하며 기도하고 있는지 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. \v 2 나는 그들이 용기를 얻고 사랑 안에서 하나가 되기를 바랍니다. 또 그들이 온전히 깨닫고 완전히 확신하는 풍성한 복을 누리기를 바랍니다. 그러면 그들은 하나님의 비밀을 알게 될 것입니다. 그 비밀은 바로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 그분이십니다. \v 3 지혜와 지식의 모든 보화가 그분 안에 감추어져 있습니다.

pt.L: Pois quero que vocês saibam quão grande luta eu tenho por vocês e pelos [que estão] em Laodiceia e por todos os que não viram o meu rosto na carne, \v 2 para que os corações deles sejam encorajados, estando unidos em amor e para toda [a] riqueza da plena certeza do entendimento, para [o] conhecimento do mistério de Deus, {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, \v 3 em quem estão escondidos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e do conhecimento.
pt.B: Quero que vocês saibam o quanto estou lutando por vocês, pelos que estão em Laodiceia e por todos os que nunca me encontraram pessoalmente. \v 2 O meu objetivo é que o coração deles seja encorajado, à medida que estão unidos em amor, e que tenham toda a riqueza de um entendimento pleno e seguro, para que conheçam o mistério de Deus, que é o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}. \v 3 Nele estão escondidos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e do conhecimento.
pt.R: Quero que vocês saibam o quanto estou trabalhando e orando por vocês, pelos irmãos na fé de Laodiceia e por todos os que nunca me viram pessoalmente. \v 2 Quero que eles sejam encorajados e unidos em amor. Quero que tenham a rica bênção de entender tudo plenamente e de ter certeza completa. Então eles vão conhecer o mistério de Deus, que é o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}. \v 3 Todos os tesouros da sabedoria e do conhecimento estão escondidos {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.

am.L: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያ ስላሉት፣ በሥጋም ፊቴን ስላላዩት ሁሉ ምን ያህል ታላቅ ተጋድሎ እንዳለኝ እንድታውቁ እወዳለሁና፤ \v 2 ይኸውም በፍቅር ተያይዘው ልባቸው እንዲጽናና፣ ወደ ማስተዋል ሙሉ እርግጠኝነት ባለጠግነት ሁሉ [እንዲደርሱ]፣ የእግዚአብሔርን ምሥጢር፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}}፣ ወደ ማወቅ [እንዲደርሱ] ነው፤ \v 3 በእርሱም የጥበብና የእውቀት መዝገቦች ሁሉ ተሰውረዋል።
am.B: ስለ እናንተ፣ በሎዶቅያ ስላሉትና በአካል አግኝተውኝ ስለማያውቁት ሁሉ ምን ያህል እየተጋደልኩ እንዳለሁ እንድታውቁ እፈልጋለሁ። \v 2 ዓላማዬም በፍቅር ተያይዘው ልባቸው እንዲበረታታ፣ በሙሉ እርግጠኝነት የሚያዝ የማስተዋልን ባለጠግነት ሁሉ እንዲያገኙ፣ በዚህም የእግዚአብሔርን ምሥጢር እንዲያውቁ ነው፤ ምሥጢሩም ራሱ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነው። \v 3 የጥበብና የእውቀት መዝገቦች ሁሉ በእርሱ ተሰውረው ይገኛሉ።
am.R: ስለ እናንተ፣ በሎዶቅያ ስላሉት አማኞችና ፊት ለፊት አይተውኝ ስለማያውቁት ሁሉ ምን ያህል እየደከምኩና እየጸለይኩ እንዳለሁ እንድታውቁ እፈልጋለሁ። \v 2 እንዲበረታቱና በፍቅር አንድ እንዲሆኑ እፈልጋለሁ። በሚገባ የማስተዋልና ፍጹም እርግጠኞች የመሆን ታላቅ በረከት እንዲኖራቸው እፈልጋለሁ። ያን ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርን ምሥጢር ያውቃሉ፤ ምሥጢሩም ራሱ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነው። \v 3 የጥበብና የእውቀት መዝገቦች ሁሉ በእርሱ ውስጥ ተሰውረዋል።

decisions.choice: a great struggle: hard effort and deep concern on their behalf, above all in prayer
decisions.reason: ἀγῶνα is the word for a contest, and picks up "struggling" at the end of chapter 1. Paul is in prison (4:3, 4:18), so his struggle for churches he has never visited is his prayer and anxious care for them; in 4:12 Epaphras is said to struggle for them "in his prayers".

decisions.choice: Laodicea: the larger neighboring city, about ten miles from Colossae
decisions.reason: Laodicea lay down the Lycus valley from Colossae. Paul sends greetings there and asks that the two churches exchange letters (4:13-16).

decisions.choice: all who have not seen Paul in person, the Colossians and Laodiceans among them; "their hearts" means all of them
alternatives: a third group besides the two churches
decisions.reason: ὅσοι ("as many as") widens the circle to everyone who has never met Paul; the Colossians are among them, since he has only heard of their faith (1:4, 1:9). In verse 2 he speaks of all of them as "their hearts".

decisions.choice: encouraged: strengthened and comforted
decisions.reason: παρακαλέω can mean to urge, to comfort or to strengthen. With "hearts" it means to give them courage, as in 4:8.

decisions.choice: knit together: joined into one
decisions.reason: συμβιβάζω means to bring together, unite; in verse 19 it is used of the body held together by its joints. In the Greek Old Testament it can mean "teach" (quoted in 1 Corinthians 2:16), but "in love" points to their being joined to one another.

decisions.choice: the riches of full assurance of understanding: understanding that is complete and certain
decisions.reason: πληροφορίας means fullness, and so full certainty (1 Thessalonians 1:5). Paul wants them to understand the gospel so well that no clever argument can shake them (verse 4).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the mystery of God, Christ"
alternatives: "the mystery of God the Father and of Christ"
"the mystery of God, which is Christ"
decisions.reason: Few verses have so many manuscript differences. Copyists expanded the short and slightly unusual phrase in several ways, for example to "of God the Father and of Christ". The SBLGNT has the short reading, found in an early papyrus and other important manuscripts, and it best explains how the others arose. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: Christ is the mystery
alternatives: "the mystery of God-Christ", calling Christ God
decisions.reason: Χριστοῦ stands beside μυστηρίου and says what the mystery is: Christ himself, as in 1:27 ("Christ in you").

decisions.choice: all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden in Christ: an echo of seeking wisdom like hidden treasure
decisions.reason: Proverbs 2:3-4 urges seeking understanding as one searches for hidden treasure. Paul says every such treasure is found in Christ, so the Colossians need look nowhere else (verse 8). ᾧ is most naturally Christ, the nearest name. "Hidden" means stored up in him, not out of reach: they are revealed to those who know him.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: never met me in person (B); never seen me face to face (R)
alternatives: have not seen my face in the flesh
decisions.reason: "In the flesh" here simply means in person.

decisions.choice: which is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out that Christ is the mystery (m8).

decisions.choice: how hard I am working and praying
alternatives: how great a struggle I have
decisions.reason: Readable says what Paul's struggle consisted of (m1).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the Colossians in the plural throughout. Every plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians. "Sus corazones" in verse 2 is Paul's "their hearts" and is not part of the setting.

decisions.choice: the settings as set out in 1:1 and 1:9: "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}", and the deity_pronoun span on every pronoun for God or Christ, "{{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}" included (for this chapter)
alternatives: the span on the title only, with no article
decisions.reason: Where Literal has no Greek article, the alternative still needs one in French ("{{christos:Christ|le Messie}}"). Balanced and Readable put the article outside the span, since "le Christ" and "le Messie" both read naturally.

decisions.choice: mystère at every level, as in 1:26-27
decisions.reason: The key word stays the same through the letter; here Balanced and Readable say at once that the mystery is Christ himself (m8).

decisions.choice: siri at every level
decisions.reason: Swahili has one ordinary word for both a secret and a mystery: "siri". It suits Paul's sense, a secret God kept and has now made known (1:26), and Readable needs no other word. "Fumbo" is a riddle or puzzle, which suggests something still hard to understand. Used for this word throughout the book.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}; spans only on free pronouns
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb ("aliyemfufua"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives such as "ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}" and "mwenyewe". The Swahili text of this chapter therefore has fewer such spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "sự hiểu biết" for epignosis (as in 1:9-10), "tri thức" for gnosis
decisions.reason: The two Greek words stand side by side in this chapter, so Vietnamese keeps them apart: "sự hiểu biết" for the knowledge of God and his will that Paul prays for, "tri thức" for the knowledge stored with wisdom in Christ. "Sự mầu nhiệm" stays the key term, as in 1:26.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}; "그분" with no deity_pronoun span, through this chapter
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: the christos alternative is plain "메시아", since Korean has no article, and the Korean text has no deity_pronoun spans, because Korean has no capital letters for the setting to change. "그리스도 그분" says "Christ himself" with the respectful "그분", and the honorific -시- ("비밀이신", "그분이십니다") marks him as Lord at every level.

decisions.choice: o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}
decisions.reason: Portuguese says "o próprio Cristo" / "o próprio Messias", which reads naturally under both options of the title setting and needs no pronoun, so there is no deity_pronoun span where the English has "himself".

decisions.choice: os irmãos na fé
decisions.reason: For the whole book: where the English Readable says "believers", Portuguese says "os irmãos na fé" or "os que creem"; "crentes" is avoided because in Brazil it names Protestants.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change, and pronouns for God and for Christ are written plainly through this chapter.

decisions.choice: ሎዶቅያ (Laodicea)
decisions.reason: The established Amharic form of the town's name, used again in 4:13, 4:15 and 4:16.

source.text: τοῦτο λέγω ἵνα μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: This I say so that no one you may delude with persuasive speech.

en.L: I say this so that no one may deceive you with persuasive arguments.
en.B: I tell you this so that no one will lead you astray with arguments that only sound convincing.
en.R: I am telling you this so that no one will fool you with clever talk that sounds true but is not.

es.L: Esto digo para que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe con palabras persuasivas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo esto para que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} desvíe con argumentos que solo parecen convincentes.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo esto para que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe con palabras astutas que suenan verdaderas pero no lo son.

fr.L: Je dis cela afin que personne ne vous trompe par des discours persuasifs.
fr.B: Je vous dis cela pour que personne ne vous égare par des arguments qui ont seulement l’air convaincants.
fr.R: Je vous dis cela pour que personne ne vous trompe avec de beaux discours qui semblent vrais mais qui ne le sont pas.

sw.L: Nasema hili ili mtu yeyote asiwadanganye kwa maneno ya kushawishi.
sw.B: Nawaambia haya ili mtu yeyote asiwapotoshe kwa hoja ambazo zinasikika tu kuwa za kweli.
sw.R: Nawaambia haya ili mtu yeyote asiwadanganye kwa maneno ya ujanja yanayosikika kuwa kweli, kumbe si kweli.

vi.L: Tôi nói điều này để không ai lừa dối anh chị em bằng những lời lẽ thuyết phục.
vi.B: Tôi nói với anh chị em điều này để không ai dẫn anh chị em đi lạc bằng những lý lẽ chỉ nghe có vẻ hợp lý.
vi.R: Tôi nói điều này để không ai lừa được anh chị em bằng những lời khéo léo, nghe có vẻ đúng mà thật ra không đúng.

ko.L: 내가 이것을 말하는 것은 아무도 그럴듯한 말로 여러분을 속이지 못하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 이 말을 하는 것은 아무도 그럴듯하게 들리기만 하는 논리로 여러분을 잘못된 길로 이끌지 못하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 이 말을 하는 이유는, 아무도 참말처럼 들리지만 사실은 거짓인 교묘한 말로 여러분을 속이지 못하게 하려는 것입니다.

pt.L: Digo isto para que ninguém os engane com argumentos persuasivos.
pt.B: Digo isso a vocês para que ninguém os desvie com argumentos que apenas parecem convincentes.
pt.R: Estou dizendo isso para que ninguém engane vocês com conversas espertas, que parecem verdadeiras mas não são.

am.L: ማንም በሚያባብል ንግግር እንዳያሳስታችሁ ይህን እላለሁ።
am.B: ይህን የምነግራችሁ ማንም አሳማኝ በሚመስል ክርክር ብቻ እንዳያስታችሁ ነው።
am.R: ይህን የምነግራችሁ ማንም እውነት በሚመስል ነገር ግን እውነት ባልሆነ የብልጠት ንግግር እንዳያታልላችሁ ነው።

decisions.choice: this: what Paul has just said, that every treasure of wisdom is in Christ
decisions.reason: τοῦτο λέγω looks back to verses 1-3: because all wisdom is in Christ, no one should be talked into looking for it elsewhere.

decisions.choice: deceive by arguments that win by seeming likely, not by being true
decisions.reason: παραλογίζομαι means to reason falsely and so mislead. πιθανολογίᾳ is speech that persuades because it sounds plausible. Paul does not name the teachers, but the rest of the chapter shows what they taught (verses 8, 16-23).

decisions.choice: arguments that only sound convincing (B); clever talk that sounds true but is not (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out that the arguments only seem sound (m2); Literal keeps "persuasive".

source.text: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: For if indeed in the flesh I am absent, yet in the spirit with you I am, rejoicing and seeing of you the order and the firmness of the in Christ faith of you.

en.L: For even if I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your good order and the firmness of your faith in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: I may be far away in body, but in spirit I am there with you. I am glad as I see your orderly life and the solid strength of your faith in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: I am not there with you in person, but I am with you in my thoughts and prayers. I am happy to see that you are living in good order and that your faith in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is strong and steady.

es.L: Porque si bien estoy ausente en la carne, sin embargo en el espíritu estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, alegrándome y viendo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} buen orden y la firmeza de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.B: Aunque estoy lejos en el cuerpo, en espíritu estoy ahí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y me alegro al ver {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida ordenada y la solidez de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: No estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en persona, pero sí en mis pensamientos y oraciones. Me alegra ver que {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} con buen orden y que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} es fuerte y firme.

fr.L: Car même si je suis absent par la chair, je suis pourtant avec vous par l’esprit, me réjouissant et voyant votre bon ordre et la fermeté de votre foi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}.
fr.B: Je suis peut-être loin de vous par le corps, mais par l’esprit je suis là avec vous, et je me réjouis de voir votre vie bien ordonnée et la solidité de votre foi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}.
fr.R: Je ne suis pas avec vous en personne, mais je suis avec vous par mes pensées et mes prières. Je suis heureux de voir que vous vivez dans le bon ordre et que votre foi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} est forte et solide.

sw.L: Kwa maana ingawa niko mbali katika mwili, lakini katika roho niko pamoja nanyi, nikifurahi na kuona utaratibu wenu mzuri na uthabiti wa imani yenu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Huenda niko mbali nanyi kimwili, lakini kiroho niko pamoja nanyi. Nafurahi ninapoona maisha yenu ya utaratibu na nguvu thabiti ya imani yenu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Siko pamoja nanyi ana kwa ana, lakini niko pamoja nanyi katika mawazo na maombi yangu. Nafurahi kuona kwamba mnaishi kwa utaratibu mzuri na kwamba imani yenu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni imara na thabiti.

vi.L: Vì dù trong xác thịt tôi vắng mặt, nhưng trong tâm linh tôi ở với anh chị em, vui mừng và thấy sự trật tự của anh chị em và sự vững chắc của đức tin anh chị em vào {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Dù tôi ở xa về thân xác, nhưng về tinh thần tôi vẫn ở với anh chị em. Tôi vui mừng khi thấy đời sống trật tự của anh chị em và đức tin vững chắc của anh chị em nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Tôi không có mặt ở đó với anh chị em, nhưng tôi vẫn ở với anh chị em trong tâm trí và lời cầu nguyện. Tôi vui khi thấy anh chị em sống có nề nếp và đức tin của anh chị em nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} thật mạnh mẽ và vững vàng.

ko.L: 비록 내가 육신으로는 떠나 있으나 영으로는 여러분과 함께 있어, 기뻐하며 여러분의 질서와 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 향한 여러분의 믿음의 굳건함을 보고 있습니다.
ko.B: 나는 몸으로는 멀리 떨어져 있지만, 영으로는 거기 여러분과 함께 있습니다. 나는 여러분이 질서 있게 사는 모습과 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 여러분의 믿음이 굳건한 것을 보고 기뻐합니다.
ko.R: 나는 지금 여러분 곁에 있지 않지만, 생각과 기도로 여러분과 함께 있습니다. 여러분이 질서 있게 살고 있고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 여러분의 믿음이 굳고 흔들리지 않는 것을 보니 기쁩니다.

pt.L: Pois, ainda que eu esteja ausente na carne, contudo estou com vocês no espírito, alegrando-me e vendo a boa ordem de vocês e a firmeza da fé de vocês {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}.
pt.B: Posso estar longe no corpo, mas em espírito estou aí com vocês. Fico alegre ao ver a vida ordenada de vocês e a sólida firmeza da fé que vocês têm {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}.
pt.R: Não estou aí com vocês pessoalmente, mas estou com vocês nos meus pensamentos e nas minhas orações. Fico feliz ao ver que vocês vivem em boa ordem e que a fé de vocês {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} é forte e firme.

am.L: በሥጋ ብርቅ እንኳ በመንፈስ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፤ ደስ እያለኝ መልካሙን ሥርዓታችሁንና {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ያላችሁን የእምነታችሁን ጽናት እያየሁ ነው።
am.B: በአካል ከእናንተ ርቄ ብሆንም በመንፈስ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ። ሥርዓት ያለውን ኑሯችሁንና {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ያላችሁን የእምነታችሁን ጽኑነት ሳይ ደስ ይለኛል።
am.R: እኔ በአካል ከእናንተ ጋር አይደለሁም፤ በአሳቤና በጸሎቴ ግን ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ። በሥርዓት እንደምትኖሩና {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ያላችሁ እምነት ጠንካራና የማይናወጥ እንደ ሆነ ሳይ ደስ ይለኛል።

decisions.choice: in the spirit: Paul's own spirit, his heart and attention, present with them
decisions.reason: πνεύματι is set against σαρκὶ ("in the flesh", that is, in body): Paul is absent in body but present in spirit, as in 1 Corinthians 5:3. He sees them through the report Epaphras brought (1:8).

decisions.choice: good order and firmness: perhaps military words, ranks drawn up and a solid front
alternatives: ordinary words for orderliness and steadiness
decisions.reason: τάξιν was used of soldiers drawn up in ranks and στερέωμα of something firm and solid; together they may picture troops holding their line against attack. Both words also have plain everyday senses, so the picture is possible rather than certain.

decisions.choice: rejoicing and seeing: rejoicing as he sees
decisions.reason: The two participles belong together: his joy comes from what he sees.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: in my thoughts and prayers
decisions.reason: Readable says how Paul is present in spirit (m1).

decisions.choice: l’esprit, lowercase
decisions.reason: Paul means his own spirit, set against his bodily absence (m1), not the Holy Spirit, so French writes it without the capital it has in 1:8.

decisions.choice: "trong tâm linh" (L), "về tinh thần" (B), lowercase
decisions.reason: Here the spirit is Paul's own, set against his body (m1), so it is not written "Thánh Linh". "Tâm linh" keeps the word "spirit" at Literal; "về tinh thần" is how Vietnamese says one is with someone in spirit though absent.

source.text: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε, ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: As therefore you received the Christ Jesus the Lord, in him walk, \v 7 having been rooted and being built up in him and being confirmed in the faith just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.

en.L: So, as you received the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, Jesus the Lord, walk in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 7 rooted and being built up in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and being made firm in the faith just as you were taught, overflowing with thanksgiving.
en.B: You have received {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus as Lord. So let your whole life be lived in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 7 with roots sunk deep in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, built up in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, made strong in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thanks to God.
en.R: You accepted {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus as your Lord. So keep living as people joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 7 Be like a tree with deep roots in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and like a building that keeps going up on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Keep growing stronger in your faith, as you were taught, and always be very thankful.

es.L: Por tanto, como {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} al {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, Jesús el Señor, {{plural_you:anden|andad}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 7 arraigados y siendo edificados en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y confirmados en la fe, así como {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} enseñados, abundando en acción de gracias.
es.B: {{plural_you:Han|Habéis}} recibido {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} como Señor. Por eso, {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} toda {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 7 con raíces hondas en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, edificados en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, afirmados en la fe como se {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó, y rebosantes de gratitud a Dios.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes aceptaron|Vosotros aceptasteis}} {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} como {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Señor. Así que {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} viviendo como personas unidas a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 7 {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} como un árbol con raíces profundas en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y como un edificio que sigue creciendo sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. {{plural_you:Sigan fortaleciéndose|Seguid fortaleciéndoos}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe, como se {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó, y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} siempre muy agradecidos.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, comme vous avez reçu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Jésus le Seigneur, marchez en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 7 enracinés et édifiés en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et affermis dans la foi selon ce qu’on vous a enseigné, débordant de reconnaissance.
fr.B: Vous avez reçu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus comme Seigneur. Vivez donc toute votre vie en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 7 profondément enracinés en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, édifiés en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, affermis dans la foi comme on vous l’a enseigné, et débordant de reconnaissance envers Dieu.
fr.R: Vous avez accepté le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus comme votre Seigneur. Alors continuez à vivre comme des gens unis à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 7 Soyez comme un arbre qui a des racines profondes en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et comme une maison qui continue à s’élever sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Continuez à devenir plus forts dans votre foi, comme on vous l’a enseigné, et soyez toujours très reconnaissants.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, kama mlivyompokea {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, yule Bwana, mwenende ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 7 mkiwa mmeshika mizizi na mkiendelea kujengwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuimarishwa katika imani kama mlivyofundishwa, mkifurika kwa shukrani.
sw.B: Mlimpokea {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kuwa Bwana. Kwa hiyo maisha yenu yote yawe ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 7 mkiwa na mizizi mirefu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mmejengwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mmeimarishwa katika imani kama mlivyofundishwa, na mkifurika kwa shukrani kwa Mungu.
sw.R: Mlimkubali {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kuwa Bwana wenu. Kwa hiyo endeleeni kuishi kama watu walioungana naye. \v 7 Kuweni kama mti wenye mizizi mirefu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na kama jengo linaloendelea kujengwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Endeleeni kuwa imara zaidi katika imani yenu, kama mlivyofundishwa, na kuweni na shukrani nyingi siku zote.

vi.L: Vậy, như anh chị em đã nhận lãnh {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Đức Giê-xu, là Chúa, hãy bước đi trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 7 đã được đâm rễ và đang được xây dựng trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và được làm cho vững vàng trong đức tin như anh chị em đã được dạy dỗ, tràn đầy sự tạ ơn.
vi.B: Anh chị em đã nhận lãnh Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} làm Chúa. Vậy hãy sống trọn đời sống mình trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 7 đâm rễ sâu trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được xây dựng trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được làm cho vững mạnh trong đức tin như anh chị em đã được dạy dỗ, và tràn đầy lòng biết ơn Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Anh chị em đã tiếp nhận Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} làm Chúa của mình. Vậy hãy tiếp tục sống như những người gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 7 Hãy như cây có rễ đâm sâu trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và như ngôi nhà không ngừng được xây cao trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ngày càng vững mạnh hơn trong đức tin, như anh chị em đã được dạy dỗ, và hãy luôn luôn biết ơn.

ko.L: 그러므로 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수, 곧 주님을 받아들인 대로, 그분 안에서 걸으십시오. \v 7 그분 안에 뿌리를 내리고 세워져 가며, 배운 대로 믿음에 굳게 서서, 감사가 넘치게 하십시오.
ko.B: 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 주님으로 받아들였습니다. 그러므로 여러분의 삶 전체를 그분 안에서 사십시오. \v 7 그분 안에 깊이 뿌리를 내리고, 그분 안에서 세워져 가며, 배운 대로 믿음에 굳게 서서, 하나님께 감사가 넘치게 하십시오.
ko.R: 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 여러분의 주님으로 받아들였습니다. 그러니 계속 그분과 하나 된 사람으로 사십시오. \v 7 그분 안에 깊이 뿌리내린 나무처럼, 그분 위에 계속 올라가는 건물처럼 되십시오. 배운 대로 여러분의 믿음이 더욱 굳건해지게 하고, 언제나 감사하는 마음이 넘치게 하십시오.

pt.L: Portanto, assim como vocês receberam o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, Jesus, o Senhor, andem {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, \v 7 enraizados e sendo edificados {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} e sendo firmados na fé, assim como foram ensinados, transbordando em ação de graças.
pt.B: Vocês receberam {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus como Senhor. Por isso, que toda a vida de vocês seja vivida {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, \v 7 com raízes profundas {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, edificados {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, fortalecidos na fé, como foram ensinados, e transbordando de gratidão a Deus.
pt.R: Vocês aceitaram {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus como o Senhor de vocês. Por isso, continuem vivendo como pessoas unidas a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \v 7 Sejam como uma árvore com raízes profundas {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} e como uma construção que vai crescendo sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Continuem ficando mais fortes na fé, como vocês foram ensinados, e sejam sempre muito agradecidos.

am.L: እንግዲህ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}}፣ ጌታ ኢየሱስን፣ እንደ ተቀበላችሁ በእርሱ ተመላለሱ፤ \v 7 በእርሱ ሥር ሰድዳችሁና እየታነጻችሁ፣ እንደ ተማራችሁም በእምነት እየጸናችሁ፣ በምስጋና እየተትረፈረፋችሁ።
am.B: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ጌታ አድርጋችሁ ተቀብላችኋል። ስለዚህ ሕይወታችሁ ሁሉ በእርሱ ይሁን፤ \v 7 ሥሮቻችሁ በእርሱ ውስጥ ጠልቀው ይግቡ፤ በእርሱ ላይ ታነጹ፤ እንደ ተማራችሁት በእምነት ጠንክሩ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም የምታቀርቡት ምስጋና የተትረፈረፈ ይሁን።
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ጌታችሁ አድርጋችሁ ተቀብላችኋል። ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ጋር አንድ እንደ ሆኑ ሰዎች መኖራችሁን ቀጥሉ። \v 7 ሥሩ በእርሱ ውስጥ ጠልቆ እንደ ገባ ዛፍ፣ በእርሱም ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እያለ እንደሚሠራ ሕንጻ ሁኑ። እንደ ተማራችሁት በእምነታችሁ እየጠነከራችሁ ሂዱ፤ ሁልጊዜም እጅግ አመስጋኞች ሁኑ።

decisions.choice: received: took over what was handed on
decisions.reason: παραλαμβάνω is the word for receiving teaching handed down (1 Corinthians 11:23; 15:1-3; 1 Thessalonians 2:13). What they received from Epaphras was Christ Jesus himself, and verse 8 warns them not to exchange him for παράδοσιν, "tradition" handed down by people.

decisions.choice: Christ Jesus as Lord
alternatives: the Christ, that is, Jesus the Lord
decisions.reason: The second article marks "the Lord" as what they received him as: the earliest confession of believers was "Jesus is Lord" (Romans 10:9; 1 Corinthians 12:3).

decisions.choice: walk: live, conduct one's life
decisions.reason: As in 1:10, "walk" is the biblical picture for the way a person lives.

decisions.choice: rooted and built up: two pictures, a tree and a building
decisions.reason: ῥιζόομαι is in the perfect: rooted once, and staying so. ἐποικοδομέω is in the present: being built up all the time. Paul joins the same two pictures in Ephesians 3:17, and 1:23 has already spoken of a foundation.

decisions.choice: made firm in the faith: in what they believe, as they were taught it
decisions.reason: πίστει, with the article, could mean "by faith" or "in the faith". "As you were taught" suggests the faith they were taught, though trust and what it believes go together.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "abounding in thanksgiving"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "in it" (in the faith). The SBLGNT has the shorter text; the meaning hardly changes.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: let your whole life be lived in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} (B); keep living as people joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} (R)
decisions.reason: "Walk" is a figure of speech for how one lives (m3); Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: like a tree with deep roots ... like a building that keeps going up
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the two pictures (m4).

decisions.choice: thanks to God
decisions.reason: Thanksgiving in Paul is always directed to God (1:3, 1:12).

decisions.choice: on vous a enseigné
decisions.reason: French does not make the person taught the subject of a passive "enseigner", so every level turns the passive "you were taught" into "on vous a enseigné". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Đức Giê-xu (L); Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The forms set for the letter in 1:1, recorded once for this chapter: Literal keeps the title first with its article, Balanced and Readable put the name first.

decisions.choice: "받아들이다" for receiving Christ
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verb as receiving what was handed on, the word for receiving teaching. "영접하다" is the familiar church word, but it pictures welcoming a guest; "받아들이다" (accept, take in) fits both a person and what is taught, and so keeps the contrast with the human "tradition" of verse 8.

source.text: Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·

records.literal_gloss: Watch out lest anyone you will be the [one] carrying off as captive through the philosophy and empty deceit according to the tradition of the men, according to the elements of the world and not according to Christ;

en.L: Watch out that there will not be anyone who carries you off as captives through philosophy and empty deceit, according to the tradition of {{gender:people|men}}, according to the elements of the world and not according to {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: Watch out, so that no one carries you off like captives by means of philosophy that is empty deceit. It follows human tradition and the elemental forces of the world, not {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: Be careful! Do not let anyone capture your minds with ideas that sound wise but are empty and false. Those ideas come from what people have handed down and from the powers and rules that run this world. They do not come from {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} que no haya nadie que {{plural_you:los|os}} lleve cautivos por medio de la filosofía y vano engaño, según la tradición de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}, según los elementos del mundo, y no según {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado de que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} arrastre como cautivos por medio de una filosofía que es engaño vacío. Esa filosofía sigue la tradición humana y las fuerzas elementales del mundo, y no {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie {{plural_you:les|os}} atrape la mente con ideas que parecen sabias pero son vacías y falsas. Esas ideas vienen de lo que la gente ha ido transmitiendo y de los poderes y reglas que dominan este mundo. No vienen {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.

fr.L: Prenez garde qu’il n’y ait personne qui vous emmène captifs par la philosophie et la vaine tromperie, selon la tradition des {{gender:humains|hommes}}, selon les éléments du monde et non selon {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.B: Prenez garde que personne ne vous emmène comme des captifs au moyen d’une philosophie qui n’est que tromperie vide. Elle suit la tradition humaine et les forces élémentaires du monde, et non le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Faites attention ! Ne laissez personne faire de vous ses prisonniers avec des idées qui semblent sages mais qui sont vides et fausses. Ces idées viennent de ce que les gens se transmettent, et des puissances et des règles qui dirigent ce monde. Elles ne viennent pas du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

sw.L: Angalieni asiwepo mtu atakayewachukua mateka kupitia falsafa na udanganyifu mtupu, kwa kufuata mapokeo ya wanadamu, kwa kufuata mambo ya msingi ya ulimwengu, wala si kwa kufuata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Jihadharini, mtu yeyote asiwachukue mateka kwa falsafa ambayo ni udanganyifu mtupu. Inafuata mapokeo ya wanadamu na nguvu za msingi za ulimwengu, wala haimfuati {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Kuweni macho! Msikubali mtu yeyote ateke akili zenu kwa mawazo yanayoonekana kuwa ya hekima, lakini ni matupu na ya uongo. Mawazo hayo yanatoka kwa mambo ambayo watu wamerithishana, na kwa nguvu na kanuni zinazotawala ulimwengu huu. Hayatoki kwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng, kẻo có ai bắt anh chị em làm tù binh bằng triết lý và sự lừa dối rỗng tuếch, theo truyền thống của loài người, theo các nguyên tố của thế gian, chứ không theo {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Hãy coi chừng, đừng để ai bắt anh chị em làm tù binh bằng thứ triết lý chỉ là lừa dối rỗng tuếch. Nó theo truyền thống của loài người và theo các nguyên lực của thế gian, chứ không theo {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận! Đừng để ai bắt giữ tâm trí anh chị em bằng những tư tưởng nghe có vẻ khôn ngoan nhưng rỗng tuếch và sai trật. Những tư tưởng ấy đến từ điều người ta truyền lại cho nhau, và từ những quyền lực và luật lệ đang chi phối thế gian này. Chúng không đến từ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 사람들의 전통을 따르고, 세상의 기초 원소들을 따르고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 따르지 않는 철학과 헛된 속임수로 누군가가 여러분을 사로잡아 가는 자가 되지 않도록 조심하십시오.
ko.B: 조심하십시오. 아무도 헛된 속임수일 뿐인 철학으로 여러분을 포로처럼 끌고 가지 못하게 하십시오. 그런 철학은 사람의 전통과 세상의 근본 세력들을 따른 것이지, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 따른 것이 아닙니다.
ko.R: 조심하십시오! 지혜롭게 들리지만 텅 비고 거짓된 생각으로 누구도 여러분의 마음을 사로잡지 못하게 하십시오. 그런 생각은 사람들이 대대로 전해 온 것과 이 세상을 다스리는 세력과 규칙에서 나온 것입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께로부터 나온 것이 아닙니다.

pt.L: Cuidado para que não haja alguém que os leve cativos por meio da filosofia e de engano vazio, segundo a tradição {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}}, segundo os elementos do mundo e não segundo {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.B: Tenham cuidado para que ninguém os leve cativos por meio de uma filosofia que é engano vazio. Ela segue a tradição humana e as forças elementares do mundo, e não {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Tenham cuidado! Não deixem que ninguém prenda a mente de vocês com ideias que parecem sábias mas são vazias e falsas. Essas ideias vêm do que as pessoas passaram de geração em geração e dos poderes e regras que governam este mundo. Elas não vêm {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.

am.L: በፍልስፍናና በከንቱ ማታለል፣ እንደ ሰዎች ወግ፣ እንደ ዓለም መሠረታዊ ነገሮች እንጂ እንደ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ባልሆነ፣ ማርኮ የሚወስዳችሁ ማንም እንዳይኖር ተጠንቀቁ።
am.B: ማንም በፍልስፍና፣ ይኸውም በከንቱ ማታለል፣ እንደ ምርኮ እንዳይወስዳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ። ይህ ትምህርት የሚከተለው የሰዎችን ወግና የዓለምን መሠረታዊ ኃይላት እንጂ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} አይደለም።
am.R: ተጠንቀቁ! ጥበብ የሚመስሉ ነገር ግን ባዶና ሐሰት በሆኑ አሳቦች ማንም አእምሮአችሁን እንዲማርክ አትፍቀዱ። እነዚያ አሳቦች የሚመጡት ሰዎች ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ካስተላለፉት ወግና ይህን ዓለም ከሚገዙ ኃይላትና ሥርዓቶች ነው። {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} የሚመጡ አይደሉም።

decisions.choice: watch out: a real danger, from someone who may already be at work
decisions.reason: With μή ("lest") Paul uses the future indicative ἔσται ("there will be"), which makes the danger concrete, and τις ("anyone") with the article and participle points to a particular person or group he does not name.

decisions.choice: carry off as captive, like plunder
decisions.reason: συλαγωγέω is a rare word meaning to carry off as booty or to kidnap. People God rescued from the authority of darkness (1:13) could be dragged back into captivity.

decisions.choice: philosophy that is empty deceit: a particular teaching, not philosophy in general
decisions.reason: One article covers both nouns, so the second explains the first: a "philosophy" that is empty deceit. In Paul's day the word could name any system of teaching about God and how to live; Josephus calls the Jewish parties "philosophies".

decisions.choice: human tradition: teaching handed down from people, not from God
decisions.reason: παράδοσιν is teaching passed from one generation to the next. Jesus set "the tradition of men" against the command of God (Mark 7:8). It contrasts with Christ, whom the Colossians "received" (verse 6).

decisions.choice: the elemental forces of the world: the basic powers and principles thought to govern life in this world, and the rules of religion bound up with them
alternatives: the elementary principles or ABCs of religion
elemental spirits: spiritual beings ruling the world
decisions.reason: στοιχεῖον means the basic parts of something: the letters of the alphabet, the elements (earth, water, air, fire) of which the world was thought to be made, or the ABCs of a subject (Hebrews 5:12). In the thinking of the time the elements were linked with the stars and with spiritual powers. In Galatians 4:3 and 4:8-10 the "elements" go with the observance of days and months and with beings that are not gods. Here they stand beside "human tradition" and against Christ, and in verses 20-22 they go with rules about food. So the word may mean elementary religious rules or the powers thought to rule the world through them; for Paul's readers the two belonged together.

decisions.choice: not according to Christ: Christ is the measure of true teaching
decisions.reason: Twice the teaching is "according to" something human or worldly; it is not κατὰ Χριστόν. In him are all the treasures of wisdom (verse 3).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: the tradition of {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general. Balanced and Readable say "human" and "people", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: the elemental forces of the world (B); the powers and rules that run this world (R)
alternatives: the elementary principles of the world
the elemental spirits of the world
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a phrase that keeps both senses of m5 open; Readable names both.

decisions.choice: capture your minds with ideas that sound wise but are empty and false
alternatives: carry you off as captives through philosophy and empty deceit
decisions.reason: Readable says what the captivity is and what "philosophy" means here (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: la tradition des {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L); humaine (B) and les gens (R), with no span
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general. French Literal needs a noun, so it carries the setting; Balanced and Readable use words that are already inclusive, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mapokeo ya wanadamu, no setting
decisions.reason: Where the English Literal has {{gender:people|men}}, Swahili "wanadamu" (human beings) already says what the Greek means, and "wanaume" would mean males only. So the Swahili has no gender span here or in verse 22.

decisions.choice: mambo ya msingi ya ulimwengu (L); nguvu za msingi za ulimwengu (B); nguvu na kanuni zinazotawala ulimwengu huu (R)
decisions.reason: "Mambo ya msingi" (the basic things) is as open as "elements" and leaves room for both senses of the meaning note; Balanced says "nguvu" (forces) as the English does, and Readable names both powers and rules. "Mafundisho" (teachings) would narrow the sense to the ABCs alone. The same words return in verse 20.

decisions.choice: "các nguyên tố của thế gian" (L); "các nguyên lực của thế gian" (B); "những quyền lực và luật lệ đang chi phối thế gian này" (R); the same in 2:20
alternatives: "những nguyên lý sơ học của thế gian"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "elements" with the plain word "nguyên tố". Balanced needs a word that keeps both senses of m5, basic forces and basic rules: "nguyên lực" (elemental forces) does so without settling the question. Readable names both, as the English does. "Thần linh" would decide for spirits, which m5 leaves open.

decisions.choice: "loài người", with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "Loài người" (humankind) already includes men and women, so the setting has nothing to change, here and in 2:22.

decisions.choice: "세상의 기초 원소들" (L); "세상의 근본 세력들" (B); "이 세상을 다스리는 세력과 규칙" (R); the same words in 2:20
decisions.reason: The Greek word means the basic parts of something: letters, the elements of the world, the first lessons of a subject. Literal keeps that with "기초 원소들"; Balanced uses "근본 세력들" so that the powers thought to stand behind the elements stay in view, as the meaning decision asks; Readable names both. The older "초등학문" (elementary learning) keeps only one sense.

decisions.choice: "사람들의 전통" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "people" or "men". Korean "사람" already means human beings of either sex, so there is nothing for the setting to change, here and in 2:22.

decisions.choice: os elementos do mundo (L); as forças elementares do mundo (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the plain word "elementos"; Balanced says "forças elementares", which, like the English, keeps both senses of m5 open (powers and basic principles). "Rudimentos", the word of older versions, now means only the first lessons of a subject.

decisions.choice: ሰዎች (people), with no gender span, here and through this chapter
decisions.reason: The English offers "men" as an alternative for anthrōpoi. Amharic "ሰዎች" already means people, men and women, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: የዓለም መሠረታዊ ነገሮች (the elements of the world, L); የዓለም መሠረታዊ ኃይላት (the elemental forces of the world, B); ይህን ዓለም የሚገዙ ኃይላትና ሥርዓቶች (the powers and rules that run this world, R)
alternatives: የዓለም የመጀመሪያ ትምህርት (the world's first lessons)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m5 takes the word as the basic powers and principles thought to govern life, with the religious rules bound up with them, not as elementary lessons. The same wording is used in 2:20.

source.text: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς, καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας, ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·

records.literal_gloss: because in him dwells all the fullness of the deity bodily, \v 10 and you are in him having been filled, who is the head of all rule and authority, \v 11 in whom also you were circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands in the stripping off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of the Christ, \v 12 having been buried with him in the baptism, in which also you were raised with [him] through the faith of the working of the God the [one] having raised him from [the] dead;

en.L: For in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all the fullness of deity dwells bodily, \v 10 and you have been filled in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, who is the head of every ruler and authority, \v 11 in whom also you were circumcised with a circumcision not done by hands, in the stripping off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 12 having been buried with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in baptism, in which you were also raised with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] through faith in the working of God, who raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from [the] dead.
en.B: For all the fullness of God's own being dwells in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} bodily, \v 10 and in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you have been made full. He is the head over every ruler and authority. \v 11 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you were also circumcised, with a circumcision no hand performed: the old life that the flesh ruled was stripped off you, in the circumcision that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives. \v 12 You were buried with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in baptism, and in baptism you were also raised with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} through faith in the power of God, who raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead.
en.R: For everything that God is lives in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, in a human body. \v 10 And because you are joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, you have everything you need. He rules over every power and authority. \v 11 When you came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, you were circumcised, but not in the way people do it. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} took away your old life that was ruled by sin. \v 12 When you were baptized, you were buried with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. And in baptism you were also raised with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to new life, because you had faith in the power of God, who raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead.

es.L: Porque en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habita corporalmente toda la plenitud de la deidad, \v 10 y {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido llenados en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, que es la cabeza de todo gobernante y autoridad, \v 11 en quien también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} circuncidados con una circuncisión no hecha a mano, en el despojamiento del cuerpo de la carne, en la circuncisión del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, \v 12 sepultados con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en el bautismo, en el cual también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} resucitados con [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] mediante la fe en la acción de Dios, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de [los] muertos.
es.B: Porque en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habita, en forma corporal, toda la plenitud del ser de Dios, \v 10 y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido llenados por completo. Él es la cabeza de todo gobernante y autoridad. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} circuncidados, con una circuncisión que no hizo mano alguna: se {{plural_you:les|os}} quitó la vida vieja dominada por la carne, en la circuncisión que da {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. \v 12 {{plural_you:Fueron|Fuisteis}} sepultados con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en el bautismo, y en el bautismo también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} resucitados con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por la fe en el poder de Dios, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos.
es.R: Porque todo lo que Dios es habita en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, en un cuerpo humano. \v 10 Y como {{plural_you:están|estáis}} unidos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} todo lo que {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}}. Él gobierna sobre todo poder y autoridad. \v 11 Cuando {{plural_you:vinieron|vinisteis}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} circuncidados, pero no de la manera en que lo hace la gente. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} {{plural_you:les|os}} quitó la vida vieja que estaba dominada por el pecado. \v 12 Cuando {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} bautizados, {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sepultados con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Y en el bautismo también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} resucitados con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} a una vida nueva, porque {{plural_you:tuvieron|tuvisteis}} fe en el poder de Dios, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos.

fr.L: Car en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} habite corporellement toute la plénitude de la divinité, \v 10 et vous avez été remplis en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, qui est la tête de toute principauté et de toute autorité, \v 11 en qui aussi vous avez été circoncis d’une circoncision qui n’est pas faite de main [d’homme], dans le dépouillement du corps de la chair, dans la circoncision du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, \v 12 ayant été ensevelis avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans le baptême, dans lequel aussi vous avez été ressuscités avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] par la foi en l’action de Dieu, qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts.
fr.B: Car c’est en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que toute la plénitude de l’être même de Dieu habite corporellement, \v 10 et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous avez été comblés. Il est la tête de toute principauté et de toute autorité. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi vous avez été circoncis, d’une circoncision qu’aucune main n’a faite : la vie ancienne que dominait la chair vous a été ôtée, dans la circoncision que donne le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 12 Vous avez été ensevelis avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans le baptême, et dans le baptême vous avez aussi été ressuscités avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} par la foi en la puissance de Dieu, qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts.
fr.R: Car tout ce que Dieu est habite dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, dans un corps humain. \v 10 Et parce que vous êtes unis à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous avez tout ce qu’il vous faut. Il règne sur toutes les puissances et toutes les autorités. \v 11 Quand vous êtes venus à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous avez été circoncis, mais pas de la façon dont les gens le font. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a enlevé votre ancienne vie, qui était dominée par le péché. \v 12 Quand vous avez été baptisés, vous avez été ensevelis avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Et dans le baptême, vous avez aussi été ressuscités avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour une vie nouvelle, parce que vous avez mis votre foi en la puissance de Dieu, qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts.

sw.L: Kwa sababu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} utimilifu wote wa uungu unaishi kimwili, \v 10 nanyi mmejazwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, aliye kichwa cha kila mtawala na kila mamlaka, \v 11 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia mlitahiriwa kwa tohara isiyofanywa na mikono, katika kuvuliwa ule mwili wa kimwili, katika tohara ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 12 mkiwa mmezikwa pamoja naye katika ubatizo, ambamo pia mlifufuliwa pamoja [naye] kupitia imani katika utendaji wa Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.B: Kwa maana utimilifu wote wa nafsi ya Mungu unakaa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika mwili, \v 10 na ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ninyi mmekamilishwa. Yeye ndiye kichwa juu ya kila mtawala na mamlaka. \v 11 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia mlitahiriwa, kwa tohara ambayo haikufanywa kwa mkono wa mtu: maisha ya zamani yaliyotawaliwa na asili ya dhambi yalivuliwa kutoka kwenu, katika tohara anayoitoa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 12 Mlizikwa pamoja naye katika ubatizo, na katika ubatizo mlifufuliwa pia pamoja naye kupitia imani katika nguvu ya Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.R: Kwa maana Mungu, kwa utimilifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, anakaa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, katika mwili wa kibinadamu. \v 10 Na kwa kuwa mmeunganishwa naye, mna kila kitu mnachohitaji. Yeye anatawala juu ya kila nguvu na mamlaka. \v 11 Mlipokuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, mlitahiriwa, lakini si kwa jinsi watu wanavyofanya. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliwaondolea maisha yenu ya zamani yaliyotawaliwa na dhambi. \v 12 Mlipobatizwa, mlizikwa pamoja naye. Na katika ubatizo mlifufuliwa pia pamoja naye kwenye maisha mapya, kwa sababu mlikuwa na imani katika nguvu ya Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu.

vi.L: Vì trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} toàn thể sự đầy trọn của thần tính cư ngụ một cách có thân thể, \v 10 và anh chị em đã được làm cho đầy trọn trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là đầu của mọi bậc cai trị và thế lực, \v 11 trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} anh chị em cũng đã được cắt bì bằng một phép cắt bì không do tay người làm, trong sự lột bỏ thân thể xác thịt, trong phép cắt bì của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 12 khi đã được chôn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong phép báp-têm, trong đó anh chị em cũng đã được sống lại với [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] qua đức tin nơi quyền năng hành động của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ [cõi] chết.
vi.B: Vì trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, toàn thể sự đầy trọn của bản thể Đức Chúa Trời cư ngụ trong một thân thể, \v 10 và trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} anh chị em đã được làm cho đầy trọn. Ngài là đầu trên mọi bậc cai trị và thế lực. \v 11 Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} anh chị em cũng đã được cắt bì, bằng một phép cắt bì không do bàn tay nào làm: đời sống cũ do xác thịt cai trị đã bị lột bỏ khỏi anh chị em, trong phép cắt bì mà {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ban cho. \v 12 Anh chị em đã được chôn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong phép báp-têm, và trong phép báp-têm anh chị em cũng đã được sống lại với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhờ đức tin nơi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết.
vi.R: Vì Đức Chúa Trời với trọn vẹn bản thể của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, trong một thân thể con người. \v 10 Và vì anh chị em được gắn liền với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, anh chị em có mọi điều mình cần. Ngài cai trị trên mọi quyền lực và thế lực. \v 11 Khi anh chị em đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, anh chị em đã được cắt bì, nhưng không phải theo cách người ta vẫn làm. {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã cất bỏ đời sống cũ của anh chị em, là đời sống bị tội lỗi cai trị. \v 12 Khi chịu báp-têm, anh chị em đã được chôn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Và trong phép báp-têm anh chị em cũng đã được sống lại với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để bước vào đời sống mới, vì anh chị em đã tin vào quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết.

ko.L: 이는 그분 안에 신성의 모든 충만함이 몸으로 거하고, \v 10 여러분도 그분 안에서 충만하게 되었기 때문입니다. 그분은 모든 통치자와 권세의 머리이십니다. \v 11 그분 안에서 여러분은 또한 손으로 하지 않은 할례를 받았습니다. 곧 육신의 몸을 벗어 버리는 가운데, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 할례로 [받았습니다]. \v 12 여러분은 세례 안에서 그분과 함께 묻혔고, 그 [세례] 안에서 또한, 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님의 일하심을 믿는 믿음을 통하여 [그분과] 함께 살아났습니다.
ko.B: 그분 안에는 하나님의 온전한 신성이 몸으로 거하고 있기 때문입니다. \v 10 그리고 여러분은 그분 안에서 충만해졌습니다. 그분은 모든 통치자와 권세의 머리이십니다. \v 11 여러분은 그분 안에서 할례도 받았습니다. 그것은 사람의 손으로 행한 할례가 아닙니다. 육신이 지배하던 옛 삶이 여러분에게서 벗겨졌으니, 이것이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주시는 할례입니다. \v 12 여러분은 세례를 받을 때 그분과 함께 묻혔고, 세례 안에서 그분과 함께 살아나기도 했습니다. 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님의 능력을 믿었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에는 하나님의 모든 것이 사람의 몸으로 살아 계시기 때문입니다. \v 10 여러분은 그분과 하나가 되었기 때문에 필요한 모든 것을 가졌습니다. 그분은 모든 세력과 권세를 다스리십니다. \v 11 여러분은 그분께 왔을 때 할례를 받았습니다. 그러나 사람들이 하는 방식의 할례는 아닙니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 죄가 지배하던 여러분의 옛 삶을 없애 주셨습니다. \v 12 여러분이 세례를 받을 때, 여러분은 그분과 함께 묻혔습니다. 그리고 세례 안에서 그분과 함께 새 생명으로 살아나기도 했습니다. 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님의 능력을 믿었기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade, \v 10 e vocês foram levados à plenitude {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, que é a cabeça de todo governante e autoridade, \v 11 em quem também vocês foram circuncidados com uma circuncisão não feita por mãos, no despojamento do corpo da carne, na circuncisão do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, \v 12 tendo sido sepultados com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} no batismo, no qual também foram ressuscitados com [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}] por meio da fé na atuação de Deus, que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou dentre [os] mortos.
pt.B: Pois toda a plenitude do próprio ser de Deus habita corporalmente {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, \v 10 e {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} vocês foram levados à plenitude. Ele é a cabeça de todo governante e de toda autoridade. \v 11 Nele vocês também foram circuncidados, com uma circuncisão que nenhuma mão realizou: a velha vida dominada pela carne foi tirada de vocês, na circuncisão que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} faz. \v 12 Vocês foram sepultados com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} no batismo, e no batismo também foram ressuscitados com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} por meio da fé no poder de Deus, que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou dentre os mortos.
pt.R: Pois tudo o que Deus é vive {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, num corpo humano. \v 10 E, porque vocês estão unidos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, vocês têm tudo de que precisam. Ele governa todo poder e toda autoridade. \v 11 Quando vocês vieram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, foram circuncidados, mas não do jeito que as pessoas fazem. {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} tirou de vocês a velha vida dominada pelo pecado. \v 12 Quando vocês foram batizados, foram sepultados com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. E no batismo vocês também foram ressuscitados com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} para uma vida nova, porque tiveram fé no poder de Deus, que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou dentre os mortos.

am.L: የመለኮት ሙላት ሁሉ በእርሱ በአካል ያድራልና፤ \v 10 እናንተም የአለቅነትና የሥልጣን ሁሉ ራስ በሆነው በእርሱ ተሞልታችኋል፤ \v 11 በእርሱም ደግሞ በእጅ ባልተደረገ መገረዝ ተገርዛችኋል፤ [ይኸውም] የሥጋን አካል በመግፈፍ፣ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} በሆነው መገረዝ ነው፤ \v 12 በጥምቀት ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀብራችሁ፣ በዚያውም ደግሞ ከሙታን ያስነሣውን የእግዚአብሔርን አሠራር በማመን [ከእርሱ ጋር] ተነሣችሁ።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ባሕርይ ሙላት ሁሉ በአካል በእርሱ ያድራልና፤ \v 10 እናንተም በእርሱ ሙሉዎች ሆናችኋል። እርሱ በአለቃና በሥልጣን ሁሉ ላይ ራስ ነው። \v 11 በእርሱ ደግሞ በእጅ ባልተደረገ መገረዝ ተገርዛችኋል፤ ሥጋ ይገዛው የነበረው አሮጌው ሕይወት ከእናንተ ተገፍፏል፤ ይህም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በሚሰጠው መገረዝ ነው። \v 12 በጥምቀት ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀበራችሁ፤ በጥምቀትም ደግሞ ከሙታን ባስነሣው በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል በማመናችሁ ከእርሱ ጋር ተነሣችሁ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የሆነው ሁሉ በሰው አካል {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ይኖራልና። \v 10 ከእርሱም ጋር አንድ ስለ ሆናችሁ የሚያስፈልጋችሁ ሁሉ አላችሁ። እርሱ በኃይልና በሥልጣን ሁሉ ላይ ይገዛል። \v 11 ወደ እርሱ በመጣችሁ ጊዜ ተገርዛችኋል፤ ነገር ግን ሰዎች በሚገርዙበት መንገድ አይደለም። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኃጢአት ይገዛው የነበረውን አሮጌውን ሕይወታችሁን አስወገደላችሁ። \v 12 በተጠመቃችሁ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀበራችሁ። በጥምቀትም ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ለአዲስ ሕይወት ተነሣችሁ፤ ይህም የሆነው ከሙታን ባስነሣው በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ስላመናችሁ ነው።

decisions.choice: deity: the very nature of God
decisions.reason: θεότης is an abstract noun from the word for God: being God, God's own nature. It is found only here in the New Testament. Not some of God's qualities but all the fullness of what God is dwells in Christ.

decisions.choice: bodily: in bodily form, in the human body of the risen Christ
alternatives: really, in substance, as opposed to shadow (verse 17)
as a whole body, all together
decisions.reason: σωματικῶς most naturally means in a body. The verb κατοικεῖ is the one used in 1:19, now in the present: in the risen Christ, who still has a human body, God's fullness lives. The sense "in reality" also fits the contrast with "shadow" in verse 17.

decisions.choice: filled, made complete: they share his fullness and lack nothing
decisions.reason: πεπληρωμένοι comes from the same root as πλήρωμα ("fullness"): the fullness is in Christ, and in him they are filled. They need no other power or practice to complete them (verses 16-23). The perfect says it is a settled state.

decisions.choice: head of every ruler and authority: over all the powers
decisions.reason: The same words for powers appear in 1:16 and 2:15. Here "head" means ruler: the powers are not his body, but they are under him, so there is no reason to fear or serve them.

decisions.choice: a circumcision not done by hands: a circumcision of the heart
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of God's covenant with Abraham (Genesis 17:10-14), and the prophets called for circumcised hearts (Deuteronomy 10:16; 30:6; Jeremiah 4:4). ἀχειροποιήτῳ ("not made by hands") marks God's own work (compare Mark 14:58). The Gentile Colossians lacked the outward sign (verse 13) but have the reality.

decisions.choice: stripping off the body of the flesh: the old life ruled by sin is put off; this is the circumcision Christ performs
alternatives: Christ's own death: "the circumcision of Christ" is the stripping off of his body on the cross
decisions.reason: ἀπεκδύσει is the noun of the verb in 2:15 and 3:9 ("you have stripped off the old self"). "Flesh" here means human nature turned from God (verse 13; Romans 8:8). "The circumcision of Christ" may be the one he performs, or his own death, when his body was stripped off; verse 12 joins believers to that death in baptism, so the two readings meet.

decisions.choice: buried with him in baptism: baptism as sharing Christ's burial
decisions.reason: Going down into the water is pictured as being buried with Christ, and coming up as rising with him (Romans 6:3-4).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: βαπτισμῷ
alternatives: the more usual noun for baptism
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts have the usual noun for baptism. The SBLGNT has a rarer form, which elsewhere means washings (Mark 7:4). The meaning here is the same.

decisions.choice: in which: in baptism
alternatives: in whom: in Christ, as at the start of verse 11
decisions.reason: ᾧ can refer to baptism, just named, or to Christ, like ἐν ᾧ ("in whom") in verse 11. Buried with him in baptism and raised with him in it make a natural pair (Romans 6:4).

decisions.choice: faith in the working of God
alternatives: the faith that God's working produces
decisions.reason: ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ most naturally says what their faith rests on: God's power, shown when he raised Jesus from the dead. Faith produced by God's working is also true to Paul (1:29), but is less likely here.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: the old life that the flesh ruled was stripped off you (B); took away your old life that was ruled by sin (R)
alternatives: in the stripping off of the body of the flesh
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the body of the flesh" means here (m6).

decisions.choice: everything that God is lives in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, in a human body
alternatives: all the fullness of deity dwells in him bodily
decisions.reason: Readable explains "fullness of deity" and "bodily" (m1, m2), and names Christ.

decisions.choice: you have everything you need
decisions.reason: Readable says what being filled in him means (m3).

decisions.choice: power
decisions.reason: Balanced says what God's "working" is: his power at work (compare 1:29).

decisions.choice: la chair (L, B) for human nature turned away from God (for the whole letter); Readable says what it means ("le péché", "vos désirs mauvais")
decisions.reason: As in Hebrews, "chair" is kept at Literal and Balanced so the reader can follow the word through 2:11, 2:13, 2:18 and 2:23, where it is set against "le corps" (m6 on 2:23). Readable gives the sense in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mwili wa kimwili
decisions.reason: Literal uses "mwili" for both body and flesh, so "the body of the flesh" would come out "mwili wa mwili", which says nothing. The adjective "kimwili" (fleshly) keeps the Greek pair visible; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m6).

decisions.choice: "thần tính" (L); "bản thể Đức Chúa Trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Thần tính" is the exact abstract noun, "being God", and keeps the single rare Greek word at Literal. It is a learned word, so Balanced and Readable say "God's own being", as the English does. "Thần tánh" is the older spelling.

decisions.choice: "cắt bì", "phép cắt bì"; "phép báp-têm"
decisions.reason: "Cắt bì" is the established Protestant word for the covenant rite; "cắt bao quy đầu" is the medical phrase, which turns a sign of the covenant into a procedure. "Báp-têm" follows the Vietnamese John; the Catholic "phép rửa" is the alternative (style guide).

decisions.choice: "세례"
decisions.reason: "세례" is the word most Korean churches use for baptism. "침례" (immersion), used by Baptist churches, would suit the picture of being buried and raised, but it settles a question of practice the Greek word does not settle here.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 일하심" (L); "하나님의 능력" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "일하심", the word chosen for the same noun in 1:29, so the reader can see that the power at work in Paul is the power that raised Christ. Balanced and Readable say what it is: God's power at work.

decisions.choice: a plenitude ... levados à plenitude
decisions.reason: m3 says the participle comes from the same root as "fullness": the fullness is in Christ, and in him they are filled. "Levados à plenitude" repeats "plenitude" so that a Portuguese reader sees the link; "completos" or "preenchidos" would lose it.

decisions.choice: a atuação de Deus
decisions.reason: Literal uses the same word as in 1:29 for this noun, so the two places stay linked; Balanced says "poder", as the English does.

decisions.choice: መለኮት (deity, L); የእግዚአብሔር ባሕርይ (God's own nature, B); እግዚአብሔር የሆነው ሁሉ (everything that God is, R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: the very nature of God. "መለኮት" is the Amharic word for the divine nature; Balanced says it in a phrase a reader will not take for a title, and Readable follows the English Readable.

decisions.choice: ሥጋ ይገዛው የነበረው አሮጌው ሕይወት (the old life the flesh ruled, B); ኃጢአት ይገዛው የነበረው አሮጌው ሕይወት (the old life ruled by sin, R)
alternatives: የሥጋ አካል (the body of the flesh) at every level
decisions.reason: For the letter: Balanced keeps "ሥጋ" for flesh, as Romans does, and Readable says what it means in each place, here the life ruled by sin (meaning decision m6), in 2:18 human thinking, in 2:23 sinful desires.

source.text: καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ· χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα, ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·

records.literal_gloss: And you, being dead in the trespasses and the uncircumcision of the flesh of you, he made alive together you with him, having forgiven us all the trespasses, \v 14 having wiped out the against us handwritten [bond] with the decrees, which was opposed to us, and it he has taken out of the middle, having nailed it to the cross;

en.L: And you, being dead in the trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made you alive together with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, having forgiven us all the trespasses, \v 14 having wiped out the handwritten bond against us with [its] decrees, which was opposed to us; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has taken it out of the way, having nailed it to the cross.
en.B: You were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, but God made you alive together with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He forgave us all our trespasses. \v 14 He wiped out the bond of debt, with its decrees, that was written against us and stood opposed to us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
en.R: Once you were dead because of the wrong things you did. You were outside God's people, with your old sinful nature still in place. But God gave you life together with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. He forgave all our sins. \v 14 It was as if we had signed a paper saying how much we owed God, because we had broken {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws. That paper stood against us. But God wiped it out. He took it away and nailed it to the cross.

es.L: Y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, estando muertos en las transgresiones y en la incircuncisión de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} carne, {{plural_you:los|os}} hizo vivir juntamente con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, habiéndonos perdonado todas las transgresiones, \v 14 habiendo borrado el acta manuscrita que había contra nosotros, con [sus] decretos, que nos era contraria; y la ha quitado de en medio, clavándola en la cruz.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes estaban|Vosotros estabais}} muertos en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} transgresiones y en la incircuncisión de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} carne, pero Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dio vida juntamente con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Nos perdonó todas nuestras transgresiones. \v 14 Borró el documento de la deuda, con sus decretos, que estaba escrito contra nosotros y nos era contrario. Lo ha quitado de en medio, clavándolo en la cruz.
es.R: Antes {{plural_you:ustedes estaban|vosotros estabais}} muertos por el mal que {{plural_you:hacían|hacíais}}. {{plural_you:Estaban|Estabais}} fuera del pueblo de Dios, y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vieja naturaleza pecadora seguía intacta. Pero Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dio vida junto con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Nos perdonó todos nuestros pecados. \v 14 Era como si hubiéramos firmado un papel que decía cuánto le debíamos a Dios, porque habíamos desobedecido {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. Ese papel estaba en contra de nosotros. Pero Dios lo borró. Lo quitó de en medio y lo clavó en la cruz.

fr.L: Et vous, qui étiez morts dans les fautes et dans l’incirconcision de votre chair, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a rendus vivants avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, nous ayant pardonné toutes les fautes, \v 14 ayant effacé l’acte de dette écrit contre nous avec [ses] prescriptions, qui nous était contraire ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a ôté du milieu, l’ayant cloué à la croix.
fr.B: Vous étiez morts dans vos fautes et dans l’incirconcision de votre chair, mais Dieu vous a rendus vivants avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il nous a pardonné toutes nos fautes. \v 14 Il a effacé la reconnaissance de dette qui était écrite contre nous, avec ses prescriptions, et qui se dressait contre nous. Il l’a fait disparaître en la clouant à la croix.
fr.R: Autrefois, vous étiez morts à cause du mal que vous faisiez. Vous étiez en dehors du peuple de Dieu, et votre vieille nature pécheresse était toujours là. Mais Dieu vous a donné la vie avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Il a pardonné tous nos péchés. \v 14 C’était comme si nous avions signé un papier disant combien nous devions à Dieu, parce que nous avions désobéi à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois. Ce papier nous accusait. Mais Dieu l’a effacé. Il l’a enlevé et l’a cloué sur la croix.

sw.L: Na ninyi, mkiwa wafu katika makosa na katika hali ya kutotahiriwa ya mwili wenu, aliwahuisha pamoja naye, akitusamehe makosa yote, \v 14 akiwa ameifuta hati iliyoandikwa kwa mkono dhidi yetu, pamoja na amri [zake], iliyokuwa kinyume chetu; naye ameiondoa njiani, akiipigilia misumari msalabani.
sw.B: Mlikuwa wafu katika makosa yenu na katika kutotahiriwa kwa mwili wenu, lakini Mungu aliwahuisha pamoja naye. Alitusamehe makosa yetu yote. \v 14 Aliifuta hati ya deni, pamoja na amri zake, iliyoandikwa dhidi yetu na kusimama kinyume chetu. Ameiondoa njiani, akiipigilia misumari msalabani.
sw.R: Zamani mlikuwa wafu kwa sababu ya mabaya mliyoyatenda. Mlikuwa nje ya watu wa Mungu, na asili yenu ya zamani ya dhambi ilikuwa bado ndani yenu. Lakini Mungu aliwapa uzima pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Alitusamehe dhambi zetu zote. \v 14 Ilikuwa kana kwamba tulikuwa tumetia sahihi karatasi inayoonyesha kiasi tulichodaiwa na Mungu, kwa sababu tulikuwa tumevunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Karatasi hiyo ilisimama dhidi yetu. Lakini Mungu aliifuta. Aliiondoa na kuipigilia misumari msalabani.
